name: Soushitsu no Hibi ~Suimin'yaku Hen~
source:
Kazuki Takashiro, a young boy, had feelings for his female cousin Aki Teshigawara.
Even though he was teased at school by a classmate from a certain country, he was happy because Aki was by his side. It was a time of happiness.

But then one day, with the arrival of bully Takeshi, those days were demolished.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ107467.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
小男孩高城一树对表妹手志河原亚希产生了感情。
虽然在学校被某个国家的同学取笑，但因为有亚纪在身边，他也很开心。那是一段幸福的时光。

但有一天，恶霸武的到来，那些日子被打破了。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ107467.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
